text: Single call to ingest text, files, or URLs — chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph automatically
quote: Give Cognee text, files, or URLs. It ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph for you in one call.

text: Recall() auto-classifies a query and picks the best retrieval strategy when no search type is specified
quote: when you do not specify a search type, `recall()` classifies the query and picks the best retrieval strategy automatically

text: .improve enriches an already-ingested graph, e.g. to bridge session memory into permanent memory
quote: Use `improve()` after Remember when you want to enrich an existing graph further. Use it at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory.

text: .forget is a unified deletion command supporting single-item, whole-dataset, or full-cleanup deletion
quote: The .forget operation is the unified deletion command in Cognee v1.0. Single data item deletion... Dataset deletion... Full cleanup

text: Official CLI lets you remember, enrich, and query memory from the terminal without writing Python
quote: The cognee-cli command lets you run Cognee from the terminal so you can remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions without opening a Python file.

text: Official MCP server connects Cognee memory to MCP-compatible assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Cline
quote: Connect Cognee to MCP-compatible AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and Cline.

text: Single Docker command runs the full Cognee container for local self-hosted deployment
quote: Quick start with Docker (single command): docker run --env-file ./.env -p 8000:8000 --rm -it cognee/cognee:main

text: Optional RDF/OWL ontology file lets you map extracted entities to a canonical domain vocabulary
quote: An ontology is an optional RDF/OWL file you can provide to Cognee. It acts as a reference vocabulary, making sure that entity types...are linked to canonical, well-defined concepts.

text: Dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage isolate data between users/organizations on one instance
quote: This system provides data isolation and access control through dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, enabling multiple users or organizations to use the same Cognee instance while keeping their data completely separate.

text: start_ui() runs the full UI and pipelines locally for free with no account required
quote: you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`

text: cognee-cli push uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud
quote: `cognee-cli push` uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud

text: cognee-cli report generates an AI-written Graph Insight Report describing a dataset's contents
quote: `cognee-cli report` writes a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains

text: remember() can write directly into a per-session cache for fast short-term retrieval
quote: cognee.remember(data, session_id="my_session") — writes content directly into the session cache for fast retrieval.

text: Cognee is open source and the full memory engine can be run locally or on your own stack for free
quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.

text: Built-in connectors ingest Slack, Notion, Linear, and Google Drive data into memory
quote: Data source integrations: Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Drive

text: Web UI lets you upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets in the browser
quote: Web UI — Upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets through the browser.

text: Code indexing capability for ingesting and searching over code repositories
quote: Code indexing for your repos

text: Custom Tasks can be created by extending DataPoints for domain-specific ingestion/processing logic
quote: Create custom Tasks for domain-specific logic by extending DataPoints

text: Cognee can be driven via Python, CLI, REST API, or MCP-compatible clients like Cursor and Cline
quote: Use it from Python, the CLI, a REST API, direct integrations like Claude Code, or MCP-compatible clients like Cursor and Cline through the Cognee MCP server.

text: .recall is the main retrieval entry point, searching memory via the best available source for a request
quote: The `.recall` operation is the main retrieval entry point in Cognee v1.0. It searches memory using the best available source for the request.

text: A session (user_id + session_id) holds an ordered list of a user's recent interactions as short-term memory
quote: A session is Cognee's short-term memory for a specific user. It is identified by `(user_id, session_id)` and stores an ordered list of recent interactions.

text: Ingesting documents produces a graph of raw information, extracted concepts, and relationships you can query
quote: Give Cognee your documents, and it creates a graph of raw information, extracted concepts, and meaningful relationships you can query.

text: Cognee ingests data in any format and builds a self-hosted knowledge graph for persistent agent memory across sessions
quote: Cognee is the open-source AI memory platform that gives AI agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. Ingest data in any format, build a self-hosted knowledge graph
